div.div: In this example, there is one static schedule being passed to the Scheduler. However, it may be extended to include one or more "Handle Watchdog" tasks, allowing for a static schedule longer than FDTI, since the watchdog is cleared at the appropriate time. Alternatively, the Watchdog can be cleared twice within FDTI to achieve higher precision/resolution of the watchdog.
